newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Costello says RBA gold sell-off right.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Costello says RBA gold sell-off right.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello on Thursday defended the Reserve Bank of Australia's sale of two-thirds of its gold reserves, saying the sale was in the national interest.
"The (bank) board took its decision in the national interest," he told reporters.
"The decision which it took was consistent with its responsibilities and the proper management of Australia's assets -- that's the important point."
The central bank said a week ago it had sold 167 tonnes of gold over the past six months, leaving it with 80 tonnes.
The bank invested the fund's raised in interest-earning foreign currency assets.
News of the sale contributed to a slump in the gold price to a 12-year low.
Australia is the world's third-biggest gold producer, but extraction costs are among the world's highest and the recent fall in gold prices means many mines are no longer viable.
